item.description:
Select several MCPs at once

The MCP list now supports standard Mac multi-selection: ⌘-click toggles rows, ⇧-click extends a range, ⌘A selects everything visible. The inspector shows one tool grid for the whole selection — a click enables or disables a tool for every selected server that allows it — and the selection can be removed behind a single confirmation. All changes still go through Preview → Apply.

Test in chat works in steps

Each message in the MCP test chat now runs a small loop: the assistant sees the conversation and the results and errors of the turn so far, gets a chance to correct a failed call, and can chain up to four tool calls before answering from real results. Run / Skip confirmations for mutating calls stay in place.

Improved

  • Add MCP search is ranked by relevance — With a query, the Featured tab shows one Results list ranked by name, then identifier, server title, summary, and tool metadata, so an exact name match no longer sinks below servers that merely mention the term in a tool description. Kind badges keep the Preset / Preconfigured / Manual setup grouping visible.
  • Tokens right in the Add sheet — Manual Store setup promotes required tokens — environment values and headers — into labeled secure fields above the key/value editor, prefilled from the app's token storage when available. Adding a managed MCP that needs a token is now: pick a mode, paste the token, stage.
  • Inspector status stays live — The inspector quietly re-checks an MCP's health when it shows it: a failed early check — for example one taken before the network was up — is retried after a short grace period the next time the row is opened, instead of pinning Not available for the whole cache window, and the tool list reloads on its own once a re-check finds the server reachable again.

Fixed

  • Integer arguments reach servers intact — Test in chat no longer turns JSON 0 and 1 into true and false when calling a tool, so servers that expect integers stop rejecting the call with a type error.
